findings.finding: The four active verdicts (p1-20261023-b00..b03-a1) have no pass-1 receipt. The pre-registered provenance chain (verdict judge label -> real agent session id) is therefore unrecorded for every batch that currently has active labels.

The local OpenCode store contains no 2026-10-23 judge session for these labels. The only sessions that mention the labels are 2026-11-13 audit sessions. Provenance cannot be reconstructed from this host; the original judge sessions live on the macOS campaign host, if they still exist.

Label date drift: config registered p1-20261022-bXX-aN and the campaign was created 2026-10-22, but the active prompts and verdicts use p1-20261023-bXX-a1. The labels are internally consistent; the campaign record is now reconciled to the observed date.

conclusion.action: Do not build, train on, or cite b00-b03 as blind pass-1 judgments. Either re-run tools/make_v4_receipt.py receipt on the macOS host that holds the original judge sessions and require result=true, or re-judge b00-b22 from scratch. Nineteen of twenty-three batches (b04-b22) still have no verdict at all.
